title: Team Seeds Management Software
description: A responsive business management system for order assignment, tracking and inventory. It includes role-based administrator access, assignment to multiple team members, product and stock management, and in-app/push notifications for assignment and status updates.

title: Expense Claim Management System
description: A business workflow system for submitting, reviewing, verifying and tracking salesperson expense claims. Separate employee and management interfaces use Google Sheets as a centralized data store, with Apps Script automating validation, reporting, status updates and notifications.

title: Blinkit Sales Dashboard
description: An interactive dashboard analyzing sales, customers, products and inventory trends. More than 25K records were cleaned and transformed using SQL, Excel and Power Query, with KPIs for total sales, AOV, quantity, delivery performance and product trends.
